title: Apple Smart Glasses May Make Their Debut at WWDC27, with Privacy Protection as the Core Selling Point
excerpt: According to the latest report by Bloomberg journalist Mark Gurman, Apple's smart glasses project (codename N50) is expected to make its debut at WWDC27 in June
content_html:
According to the latest report by Bloomberg journalist Mark Gurman, Apple's smart glasses project (codename N50) is expected to make its debut at WWDC27 in June 2027 and be officially released in autumn 2027. The product was originally planned for release later this year and launch in early 2027, but has been delayed due to factors such as product refinement and improvement of privacy strategies.

The report states that Apple is making privacy protection a core focus of its smart glasses development. In response to camera privacy controversies caused by competitors like Meta, Apple not only improves related features and policies, but also explores multiple product solutions, including removing the camera and retaining only AI interaction, audio playback, and call capabilities, or keeping the camera but completely disabling photo and video recording functions, using it only for environmental perception and providing visual information to AI. These designs will also be integrated with the iPhone's visual intelligence and future camera-equipped AirPods plans.

In terms of privacy mechanisms, Apple may draw inspiration from Meta's recording indicator light design and test several new software and hardware privacy protection technologies. Mark Gurman said that Apple will continue to adhere to its long-standing "privacy-first" philosophy, and is expected to focus on promoting edge AI processing capabilities, avoiding sensitive features such as facial recognition, and will not introduce a "super-perception" mode similar to Meta, nor will it use user audio and video data to train AI models.

As AI smart glasses become a key focus for tech giants, Apple aims to establish a differentiated competitive advantage through privacy protection and edge AI capabilities, which may further drive the smart glasses market toward a more secure and trustworthy direction.

content_html_zh:
据彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 最新报道，苹果智能眼镜项目（代号 N50）预计将于 2027 年 6 月的 WWDC27 上首次亮相，并于 2027 年秋季正式发布。 该产品原计划于今年晚些时候发布，并于 2027 年初推出，但由于产品细化和隐私策略改进等因素而被推迟。

报道称，苹果正在将隐私保护作为其智能眼镜开发的核心重点。 针对Meta等竞争对手引发的摄像头隐私争议，苹果不仅完善了相关功能和政策，还探索了多种产品解决方案，包括去掉摄像头，只保留AI交互、音频播放和通话功能，或者保留摄像头，但完全禁用拍照和视频录制功能，仅用于环境感知，为AI提供视觉信息。 这些设计还将与 iPhone 的视觉智能和未来配备摄像头的 AirPods 计划相结合。

在隐私机制方面，苹果可能会从Meta的录音指示灯设计中汲取灵感，测试几项新的软硬件隐私保护技术。 Mark Gurman 表示，苹果将继续秉承长期以来的“隐私优先”理念，预计将重点推广边缘 AI 处理能力，避开面部识别等敏感功能，不会引入类似 Meta 的“超感知”模式，也不会使用用户音视频数据来训练 AI 模型。

随着AI智能眼镜成为科技巨头重点关注的焦点，苹果旨在通过隐私保护和边缘AI能力建立差异化竞争优势，这或将进一步推动智能眼镜市场朝着更安全、更值得信赖的方向发展。
